# Battery level (`battery`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Device · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True when the battery charge is within the given range.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `above` | whole number (0–100) | no |  | True when the charge is above this percentage. |
| `below` | whole number (0–100) | no |  | True when the charge is below this percentage. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: battery
    below: 30
```

## Notes

False on computers without a battery.
